title: 项目内容3：全链路问答准确率与响应时间正式实验协议

tool_selection_accuracy.rule: set(selected_tools) equals set(expected_tools); repeated calls of the same expected tool do not cause failure

correct_when: request completed without API or workflow error
every frozen answer fact is present in final user-facing answer

overall_qa_accuracy_case_majority.correct_when: at least 2 of 3 repeats are request-level correct

latency.scope: FastAPI receipt through final answer of every scored request
latency.primary: arithmetic mean over 150 warmed scored requests

answer_scoring.judge: deterministic frozen fact coverage; no LLM-as-judge
answer_scoring.fact_rule: each answer_facts item passes if any one of its any_of strings occurs after normalization
answer_scoring.structured_reference: read-only Cypher executed and frozen during preflight
answer_scoring.graphrag_reference: must-have facts copied from frozen source files
answer_scoring.mixed_reference: all structured and source facts are required
answer_scoring.manual_review: may annotate ambiguous outputs but cannot convert a deterministic failure into a pass after seeing aggregate results

failure_policy.http_error: incorrect and included in latency if a measured response time exists
failure_policy.timeout: incorrect; latency recorded as timeout ceiling
failure_policy.resume: checkpoint resume allowed only when all frozen hashes and protocol version match

legacy_exclusion.reason: its old experiment_3 measures Text2Cypher workflow success, not project-content-3 full-agent QA
